name: Score-route comparison
task: For scores 4, 5, 6 and 7, compare a strictly abstract two-point finishing route with a one-point finishing route. Identify why equality of estimated turns fails when legal prerequisites differ.

name: Opportunity-cost review
task: Set up two hypothetical actions: take one point and expose a unit, or retain the unit for later. Record rival responses and alternate win routes before selecting; no universal numeric point price.

name: Clock and outs
task: Use a fictional match with a remaining time budget. Identify live recovery routes and their time requirements; compare continuing with voluntary concession without treating uncertain loss as impossible or arranging outcomes.

name: Practice loop
task: Record duration and errors over five solo repetitions; change one routine and repeat. Separate execution speed from match strength.

name: Public card ledger
task: A card enters play, returns to hand, is played again, then another copy is revealed. Maintain distinct identity counts and unknowns instead of counting appearances.

name: Response budget
task: Use an invented two-dimensional resource model to compare feasible and infeasible responses; no actual card costs assumed.

name: Uncertain tells
task: Write three compatible explanations for one observable action. Choose a decision robust across them without asserting hidden information.

name: Bluff cost
task: Compare a legal represented response against developing a threat. Record the outcome if the rival respects it and if the rival ignores it.
